interface.longDescription: Discover Agent Skills in GitHub repositories you choose. Review candidates and manage selected native skills in a separate private plugin that belongs to you. Installation, removal and updates require your explicit approval and access to Plugin Creator. The public manager includes no third-party skills or preset repositories; read-only repository discovery works without Plugin Creator.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find Agent Skills in a GitHub repository I choose and help me select what to install.

name: skills-manager-public
description: Discover user-selected GitHub Agent Skills and manage each user’s separate private collection with review and approval.
